file_change_proposal.description: Windows absolute path with a drive letter

note: SC-9/A1(c) pin for isSafeRelativePath. The POSIX absolute path is rejected by the empty-leading-segment rule ('/etc/passwd' splits to ['','etc','passwd']); the Windows drive-letter path has no empty segment and needs its own test, so both forms are exercised here. policy_violations is compared element-by-element, so weakening either path to 'outside_allowed_paths' fails the comparison. An explicit startsWith('/') guard was written alongside these and guard-ablation proved it dead — deleting it left every fixture green — so it was removed rather than exempted.
